verdict.rationale: The Angular CLI documents a command that "Configures the gathering of Angular CLI usage metrics", a first-party control over CLI usage tracking. The evidence only implies that this control includes an opt-out and gives no further detail. missing for 10: explicit documentation of disabling or opting out, per-user, global and CI-level opt-out details, any statement on telemetry beyond the CLI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
